name: Orange Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Orange Beach?
seo_title: Orange Beach golf cart map and LSV map
answer_short: Yes, on low-speed streets. In Orange Beach, state-tagged golf carts and LSVs may only use streets posted 25 mph or less, and not the state highways (AL 59, 180, 182 and 161). Posted signs win.

lsv.notes: Local cap is lower than the usual 35

rules.rule: Carts and LSVs not on streets posted over 25 mph

It is a violation to operate a cart on any sidewalk, street, road, or highway that is not a designated cart street. Canal Road (AL 180) is a state highway with a limit over 40 mph and is not on the designated list.

Adopted November 4, 2025 (council 4-0). It re-enacts Chapter 70, Article VIII. The findings describe definition and scrivener corrections. Sec. 70-275(c) still makes it a violation to operate a cart on any sidewalk, street, road, or highway that is not a designated cart street. The ordinance does not add a crossing exception for AL 180 / Canal Road, does not raise the 25 mph designation cap, and does not designate the Canal Road Multi-Use Trail as a multi-use cart path.

banned_roads.name: AL 180 (Fort Morgan Rd / Canal Rd)
banned_roads.rule: State highway; crossing rules not confirmed; ask Orange Beach Police

faq.q: Is there a golf cart trail along Canal Road in Orange Beach?
faq.a: Canal Road (AL 180) itself is not a designated cart street, so carts may not be operated on that roadway (Orange Beach Sec. 70-275(c); Ord. 2024-1487, as amended by Ord. 2025-1521). The city has a 10-foot Canal Road Multi-Use Trail, described in the city's Canal Road Multi-Use Trail bid document and a city news post. That trail is not on our map yet. The ordinance defines a multi-use path and a multi-use cart path (Sec. 70-273); we have not found a city designation of this trail as a multi-use cart path.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Orange Beach?
faq.a: Streets posted 25 mph or less. Local cap is lower than the usual 35. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Beach Blvd?
faq.a: No. Beach Blvd is AL 182, a state highway, and carts and LSVs are limited to streets posted 25 mph or less.

faq.q: Does an LSV get more roads than a golf cart in Orange Beach?
faq.a: Not here. The local rule caps both at streets posted 25 mph or less.
